verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a first-party webhook plugin. It gives access to error and project data as soon as BugSnag receives and processes them, and it sends a message to a user-specified URL with event, error, project and account information. That is a registrable outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is a thin set of short doc excerpts. Missing for 10: documentation of which event types can be subscribed to or filtered, payload schema details, delivery guarantees such as retries or signing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
